title: Kissed Smoky Algerian Sweetcorn Tagine
description: A hearty and earthy Algerian dish featuring sweetcorn, perfect for a lazy Sunday, made with robata-grill and served in individual mini cocottes, whole30 friendly.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium high heat.
Grill the sweetcorn for 10-12 minutes, turning frequently, until lightly charred.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes, until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the grilled sweetcorn and chicken broth to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, until the liquid has reduced slightly.
Divide the mixture among individual mini cocottes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
